Good, no stale claims remain. The knowledge base update for REQ-003 is complete.

**Report:**

Files written (all within `aiws/knowledge/**` as required by write scope):
- `system-map.md` — added `CustomerHandler`/`CustomerService`/`CustomerRepository`/`InMemoryCustomerRepository` entries for the new status endpoint; added `UpdateCustomerStatusRequest`, `describeStatusError.js` to component tables; added FE main.js listener description; inserted a new numbered flow "Đổi trạng thái khách hàng" (flow 6, renumbering legacy flows to 7/8); rewrote the Legacy → Hành vi "Đổi `status`" row (now implemented, BR-09 kept from legacy).
- `api-inventory.md` — added the `PUT /api/customers/{id}/status` row to the endpoint table; added a dedicated processing-order subsection (route match → malformed JSON → 404 → invalid status → idempotent same-status → BR-09 check → write) mirroring the existing `PUT .../{id}` subsection; updated the error-key set and the "three separate write endpoints" convention note.
- `db-schema.md` — corrected the now-stale "no way to change status after insert" claim; added `updateStatus` to the repository method table; documented that reactivation compares the phone verbatim (no re-normalization) and only when non-null; updated the migration note so it's clear status-change doesn't re-check phone format (unlike `PUT .../{id}`).
- `glossary.md` — added "Đổi trạng thái" and "Kích hoạt lại" terms; updated "Thao tác", "Đang hoạt động", "Ngừng hoạt động", BR-09, and "Không tìm thấy" entries to reference the new endpoint.
- `conventions.md` — updated the BE test note (HTTP tests can now construct `INACTIVE` customers via the API itself, no longer `[CẦN XÁC NHẬN]`-style limitation); documented that `updateStatus` deliberately bypasses `check`; added the REQ-003 TC range (TC-82..TC-107) and the TC-74 amendment note; added `describeStatusError.js` as the first FE utils function returning user-facing Vietnamese text; updated naming/style examples and the three-way FE error-handling pattern.

All claims are backed by direct reads of the REQ-003 source files (`CustomerHandler.java`, `CustomerService.java`, `CustomerRepository.java`, `InMemoryCustomerRepository.java`, `UpdateCustomerStatusRequest.java`, `customerApi.js`, `customerTable.js`, `describeStatusError.js`, `main.js`) and verified test files for the real TC numbering rather than trusting the design doc alone — implementation matched the design exactly, so no `[CẦN XÁC NHẬN]` markers were needed for the new behavior itself. No other knowledge sections were touched.
